title: limoniastrum guyonianum var. ouarglense
intro: Limoniastrum guyonianum var. ouarglense, commonly known as Ouargli spiny restharrow, is a plant species within the family Brassicaceae. The plant has been traditionally used in North African and Middle Eastern folk medicine to treat various ailments. It is believed to possess health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions, including reducing pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Ouargli spiny restharrow include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
